run_tests_critical_and_other: run critical tests first then other tests in parallel using a process pool executor
run_test_single_module: run a single test module by name and return its execution time and exceptions
iterfutures_yield_completed: iterate over a set of futures yielding each completed future as it finishes
last_failed_test_read: read the last failed test name from test_results.txt or return None if not found
reorder_tests_move_first: reorder a test list by moving a specified test to the front of the list
